headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:VRTX) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations, Full-Year Outlook Slightly Exceeds Expectations
summary: Biotech company Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:VRTX) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 12.5% year on year to $3.33 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $13.15 billion at the midpoint came in 0.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.73 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
